title: God's Amazing Animals Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of God's amazing animal creation and what makes each animal kind special!

questions.question: What makes mammals different from other animals?
options: They have fur or hair and feed babies milk
questions.explanation: Mammals are warm-blooded animals that have fur or hair and feed their babies milk. God designed them with these special features.

questions.question: On which day of Creation did God make birds?
questions.explanation: God created birds on Day 5 of Creation along with the sea creatures (Genesis 1:20-21).

questions.question: How do fish breathe underwater?
questions.explanation: God designed fish with special organs called gills that take oxygen right out of the water.

questions.question: What kind of skin do reptiles have?
questions.explanation: Reptiles have dry, scaly skin. God designed their scales to protect them and help them survive.

questions.question: How many legs do all insects have?
questions.explanation: All insects have exactly 6 legs. This is one of the features God designed to identify the insect kind.

questions.question: What does the Bible tell us to learn from the ant?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 6:6 says, 'Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider its ways and be wise!' God wants us to learn hard work from the ant.

questions.question: What is stewardship?
options: Taking care of what God has given us
questions.explanation: Stewardship means taking care of what belongs to God. He gave humans the responsibility to care for His creation (Genesis 1:26, 28).

questions.question: What does 'according to their kinds' mean in Genesis?
options: Animals can turn into other animals
God created each animal kind special and unique
questions.explanation: God created each animal 'according to its kind,' meaning each kind of animal was specially designed and created by God from the very beginning (Genesis 1:24-25).
